newsitem.title: USA: Hartford crime falls to 10-year low - report.
newsitem.headline: Hartford crime falls to 10-year low - report.

text.p: Major crime in Hartford fell 20 percent in 1996, a 10-year low, Hartford Courant reported Tuesday.
It said most cities in the state had declines ranging from one percent to 9.5 percent.
Major crime in Bridgeport, Connecticut's biggest city, rose 4.6 percent last year, while New Haven saw a slight decline of 0.9 percent.
Crime in Hartford decreased in every major category and in all but one of its 17 neighborhoods.
The drop is credited to more police officers on the streets, a spotlight on the city by federal, state and municipal gang forces, and stronger community policing tactics.
Homicides fell to 21 in 1996 from 57 in 1994 and 36 in 1995. The city has recorded six homicides so far this year.
